list.captured: Data version {from}, before the move to {to}: {rows, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, taken {date}
list.empty: No data snapshots. One is taken before each upgrade that migrates this plugin's data.
list.loadFailed: Couldn't read this plugin's data snapshots.
list.skipped: No snapshot of data version {from}: the move to {to} on {date} ran without one, for lack of space. That data cannot be restored.
list.title: Data snapshots

notice.checkFailed: Couldn't check what this does to the plugin's data, so it can't go ahead.
notice.restore: Rolling back also puts {name}'s data back as it was on {date}. The {currentRows, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} it has now are replaced by the {snapshotRows, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} in that snapshot, and anything it saved since is lost.
notice.unavailable: v{version} cannot read {name}'s current data (migrated to data version {current}), and no snapshot from before that migration is left. Delete the plugin's data first if you still want to roll back.

space.body: Upgrading {name} migrates its data from version {from} to {to}. A snapshot of the current data, about {required}, would let a rollback bring it back.
space.consequence: Without a snapshot, rolling back to a version before data version {to} cannot bring this data back.
space.ranOut: Storage ran out while writing it.
space.title: Not enough space to keep a data snapshot
